name: below_usd_3m_but_innovative
description: A formal procurement action concerns a novel pilot, but its novelty does not change the procurement category.

candidates.title: Metro procures a low-cost trial of recyclable platform panels
candidates.search_snippet: The metro procured a small pilot of recyclable platform panels.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic pilot award notice. The metro procured a pilot installation of recyclable platform panels at one station. The notice describes the material composition, safety tests, installation method, monitoring plan, and trial objectives.

contract_notes: The source substantiates a formal procurement action; that action determines Category.
Pilot purpose, technical novelty, and the USD 3M importance signal do not override PROCUREMENT.
The E&M taxonomy and Reportability remain independent outcomes.
